title: Lower shriek of module objects for a compactification
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and let $c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ be a compactification of $f$ ([sk-def-nagata-sketch-data]): $f=g\circ i$, $i$ a quasi-compact open immersion, and $g$ proper. For $T=X,\bar X,Y$, write $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for the pulled-back coefficient ring ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]) and $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ for the category of module objects ([sk-def-sfb-module-objects]). The *lower shriek attached to $c$* is

$$
f^c_!:=g_*\circ i_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_Y},
$$

the extension by zero along $i$ ([def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]) followed by the pushforward of module objects $g_*\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_{\bar X}}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}$ of [def-sfb-module-lower-star], including the restriction of scalars along $\eta_g\colon\Lambda_Y\to g^{\Ab}_*\Lambda_{\bar X}$ built into that functor.
